translations.title: Subsidies & Incentives
translations.h1: Subsidies and Incentives Advisory in Haryana
translations.short_description: Pursue the subsidy potential of your Haryana investment with scheme assessment, documentation, application and follow-up support from Rapid.

sections.title: Unlock the full subsidy potential of your next investment
sections.html:
From identifying relevant incentives to preparing applications and managing follow-ups, Rapid takes ownership of the work, helping your business pursue the full benefit its project qualifies for.

Whether you are building a first unit, expanding a plant or investing in specific equipment, we connect the opportunity, project records and application process around your business.

sections.title: What can subsidy advisory help you achieve?

items.title: Identify opportunities you may not know by name
items.html: Describe the unit and investment in familiar terms. Rapid examines relevant programmes and identifies the project facts that determine which opportunities deserve further work.

items.title: Plan commitments with the application in mind
items.html: Orders, payments, construction and production dates can matter. An early review lets the team consider the sequence before more commitments are fixed.

items.title: Carry a documented application forward
items.html: Bring the cost trail, required professional inputs and departmental responses into one coordinated file, with clear next actions.

sections.title: What kinds of benefit should you understand?
sections.html:
Benefit type What it generally addresses
Capital assistance A defined portion of eligible investment under a programme.
Interest support Specified borrowing-cost assistance, usually through a defined route and period.
Reimbursement Eligible expenditure supported by the required evidence and claim process.
Tax/duty-linked incentive A particular levy or payment subject to the programme's conditions.

These describe different mechanisms, not benefits available to every business. The scheme page owns its current rates, caps, dates and conditions. Explore the Scheme Directory.

sections.title: How do we establish which schemes fit?
sections.html:
A useful assessment connects the applicant, activity, location, expenditure and dates. It distinguishes a new unit from an expansion and a whole project from an individual eligible asset.

Official programme information changes. Haryana's MSME Directorate now lists 2026 policy material alongside earlier policies; a legacy scheme name alone does not establish the governing route for a new investment. Haryana policy directory. For food projects, the relevant MoFPI guidelines and amendments must be read with the applicable invitation and project facts.

sections.title: What Rapid delivers
sections.html:
Stage What you receive from the agreed assignment
Opportunity review A shortlist of relevant routes and the eligibility questions to settle.
Evidence preparation A project-specific checklist, cost/date record and outstanding-input list.
Application work Coordinated application material and a submission record.
Queries and follow-ups A record of observations, responses and next actions.
Later claim stages, if included Coordination of the particular evidence and follow-ups agreed for that stage.

We define which stages are included before work begins. Your business and CA confirm financial facts and certifications. The authority or lender decides eligibility, sanction and release.

sections.title: Information for a useful assessment
sections.html:
Bring Why it matters
Activity, entity and district Identifies the applicant and project setting.
Site and possession records Establishes where the investment is made.
Machinery, building and other costs separately Makes the eligible-cost question answerable.
Quotations, invoices and payments Distinguishes proposed and incurred expenditure.
Order, construction and production dates Shows the sequence against programme conditions.
Existing permissions and earlier assistance Identifies prerequisites and overlap questions.

You do not need a polished project report to make the first call. Bring the facts you have; we explain which further records the chosen assignment needs.

items.title: 1. Understand the investment
items.html: Establish the activity, scale, location and stage, including money already committed.

items.title: 2. Review relevant opportunities
items.html: Identify the programme and evidence needed to assess fit, rather than treating the directory as an eligibility list.

items.title: 3. Prepare and coordinate the application
items.html: Organise records and professional inputs, then track the agreed submission and responses.

items.title: 4. Follow the relevant decision or claim stage
items.html: Keep the next action clear. Application, sanction and disbursement are different milestones and should be recorded separately.

sections.title: Fees and timing
sections.html: Rapid's fee depends on the programme, stage and agreed work. Official charges and professional certifications, where relevant, are identified separately. Preparation, authority review and later release can have different schedules. A subsidy should not be treated as cash already available to pay a supplier.

sections.html:

Read the manufacturing case

items.title: Can you identify the scheme for us?
items.html: Yes. Start with the business and investment; you do not need to know the programme name.

items.title: Can we apply after buying machinery?
items.html: Share the actual dates. The particular programme determines whether and how the incurred expenditure can be considered.

items.title: Can different benefits be combined?
items.html: The overlap and eligible expenditure need checking against each programme. Disclose previous assistance and live applications.

items.title: Will every rupee of project cost qualify?
items.html: Not necessarily. Keep land, building, machinery and other costs separate for the relevant calculation.

items.title: Can our CA remain involved?
items.html: Yes. We coordinate the agreed application around the people who own the financial and technical inputs.

translations.title: सब्सिडी और इंसेंटिव
translations.h1: हरियाणा में सब्सिडी और इंसेंटिव के लिए सलाह व सहायता
translations.short_description: नई यूनिट, विस्तार या उपकरण निवेश के लिए योजना की पहचान, दस्तावेज़, आवेदन और फॉलो-अप में रैपिड की सहायता लें।

sections.title: अपने अगले निवेश के लिए उपलब्ध सब्सिडी का पूरा लाभ उठाएँ
sections.nav_label: अपने अगले निवेश के लिए उपलब्ध सब्सिडी का पूरा लाभ उठाएँ
sections.html:
आपके प्रोजेक्ट के लिए उपयुक्त योजना ढूँढने से लेकर आवेदन तैयार करने और फॉलो-अप तक, रैपिड तय किए गए काम की ज़िम्मेदारी लेता है। मकसद है कि आपका कारोबार जिस लाभ का पात्र हो, उसके लिए सही तैयारी और पूरा प्रयास हो।

नई यूनिट, प्लांट का विस्तार या किसी खास उपकरण की खरीद, शुरुआत आपके निवेश से होती है। योजना का नाम पहले से जानना ज़रूरी नहीं है।

sections.title: सब्सिडी की तैयारी से क्या फायदा होता है?

items.title: सही अवसर पहचानना
items.html: बताएँ कि आप क्या बनाते हैं, कहाँ निवेश कर रहे हैं और किस चीज़ पर खर्च होगा। हम संबंधित योजनाओं और पात्रता के सवालों को आपके प्रोजेक्ट से जोड़कर देखते हैं।

items.title: खरीद और निर्माण का क्रम तय करना
items.html: ऑर्डर, भुगतान, निर्माण और उत्पादन की तारीखें महत्वपूर्ण हो सकती हैं। पहले बातचीत होने से आगे की प्रतिबद्धताएँ करने से पहले योजना की शर्तें देखी जा सकती हैं।

items.title: आवेदन को व्यवस्थित तरीके से आगे बढ़ाना
items.html: खर्च के प्रमाण, ज़रूरी प्रमाणपत्र और विभाग के सवाल एक जगह रखने से अगला काम और उसकी ज़िम्मेदारी स्पष्ट रहती है।

sections.title: अलग-अलग तरह के लाभ समझें
sections.html:
लाभ आम तौर पर किससे जुड़ा होता है
पूँजीगत सहायता योजना के अनुसार पात्र निवेश के एक हिस्से से।
ब्याज सहायता तय ऋण, अवधि और शर्तों के अंतर्गत ब्याज खर्च से।
खर्च की प्रतिपूर्ति पात्र खर्च के भुगतान और उसके प्रमाण से।
कर या शुल्क से जुड़ा इंसेंटिव किसी विशेष भुगतान और योजना की शर्तों से।

इनमें से हर लाभ हर कारोबार को नहीं मिलता। दर, सीमा, आवेदन की तारीख और पात्र खर्च की जानकारी संबंधित योजना के पेज (English) पर देखनी चाहिए।

sections.title: रैपिड क्या काम संभालता है?
sections.html:
चरण तय दायरे में मिलने वाला काम
अवसर की समीक्षा संबंधित योजनाएँ और पात्रता के खुले सवाल।
दस्तावेज़ों की तैयारी प्रोजेक्ट के अनुसार चेकलिस्ट और खर्च व तारीखों का रिकॉर्ड।
आवेदन आवश्यक जानकारी और पेशेवर इनपुट का समन्वय।
प्रश्न और फॉलो-अप विभाग की टिप्पणियों, जवाबों और अगले कदम का रिकॉर्ड।
आगे का क्लेम चरण प्रस्ताव में शामिल होने पर उस चरण के प्रमाण और फॉलो-अप।

आप और आपके CA वित्तीय तथ्यों की पुष्टि करते हैं। विभाग या बैंक पात्रता, मंज़ूरी और भुगतान का निर्णय करता है। हम पहले ही स्पष्ट करते हैं कि कौन से चरण हमारी फीस में शामिल हैं।

sections.title: पहली बातचीत में क्या लाएँ?
sections.html:
कारोबार और जिला, साइट के कागज़, मशीनरी व बिल्डिंग का अलग-अलग खर्च, कोटेशन या बिल, भुगतान और उत्पादन की तारीखें, मौजूदा मंज़ूरियाँ और पहले मिली सहायता की जानकारी लाएँ। पूरा प्रोजेक्ट रिपोर्ट तैयार होना ज़रूरी नहीं है। जो उपलब्ध है, उससे शुरुआत करें।

हरियाणा के MSME विभाग पर नई और पुरानी नीतियाँ अलग-अलग उपलब्ध हैं। पुराने योजना-नाम को देखकर नई खरीद की पात्रता मान लेना सही नहीं होगा।

items.title: 1. निवेश को समझना
items.html: नई यूनिट, विस्तार और पहले हो चुके खर्च को अलग करके देखते हैं।

items.title: 2. संबंधित योजना की शर्तें देखना
items.html: आवेदक, गतिविधि, जगह, खर्च और तारीखों को योजना से मिलाते हैं।

items.title: 3. आवेदन और जवाब तैयार करना
items.html: ज़रूरी रिकॉर्ड जुटाकर तय आवेदन और विभागीय प्रश्नों का समन्वय करते हैं।

items.title: 4. अगले चरण तक फॉलो-अप
items.html: आवेदन, मंज़ूरी और पैसा मिलना अलग पड़ाव हैं। हर पड़ाव का सही रिकॉर्ड रखा जाता है।

sections.title: हमारे काम का उदाहरण
sections.html:
हिसार की एक मैन्युफैक्चरिंग यूनिट के लगभग ₹49 लाख के मशीनरी और बिल्डिंग निवेश से जुड़े रिकॉर्ड रैपिड ने पूँजीगत सब्सिडी आवेदन के लिए व्यवस्थित किए। केस स्टडी पढ़ें (English)।

सिरसा के टेस्टिंग उपकरण वाले मामले (English) में काम एक खास उपकरण निवेश पर केंद्रित था। ये रकम निवेश की हैं, मिली हुई सब्सिडी या कंपनी के टर्नओवर की नहीं।

sections.title: फीस और समय
sections.html: फीस योजना, आवेदन के चरण और उपलब्ध रिकॉर्ड के अनुसार तय होती है। सरकारी शुल्क और अलग पेशेवर काम की लागत स्पष्ट रखी जाती है। संभावित सब्सिडी को सप्लायर को देने के लिए पहले से उपलब्ध पैसा न मानें।

items.title: मशीन खरीद ली है, अब बात कर सकते हैं?
items.html: हाँ। वास्तविक तारीखें बताएँ। संबंधित योजना के आधार पर आगे का रास्ता देखा जाएगा।

items.title: क्या दो योजनाओं का लाभ साथ मिल सकता है?
items.html: दोनों की शर्तें और खर्च में दोहराव जाँचना होगा। पहले के लाभ और चालू आवेदन बताएँ।

items.title: क्या हमारा CA साथ काम कर सकता है?
items.html: हाँ। वित्तीय रिकॉर्ड और प्रमाणपत्र की ज़िम्मेदारी उनके पास रखते हुए आवेदन का समन्वय किया जा सकता है।

sections.title: अपने प्रोजेक्ट पर बात करें
sections.html: कारोबार, जगह और मौजूदा ज़रूरत के बारे में बताएँ। रैपिड के विशेषज्ञ सलाहकार आपको कॉल करके काम का दायरा, फीस और अगले कदम समझाएँगे।

sections.title: स्रोत और समीक्षा
sections.html: संबंधित सेवाओं के पेज पर आधिकारिक संदर्भ दिए गए हैं। जानकारी की जाँच 16 सितंबर 2026 को की गई। अतुल गोयल (English) समीक्षा के लिए नामित हैं; विषय की अंतिम विशेषज्ञ समीक्षा अभी बाकी है।

translations.title: Statutory Approvals
translations.h1: Statutory Approval Support in Haryana
translations.short_description: Coordinate CLU, building, fire, pollution and other project approvals in Haryana. Rapid connects documents, technical inputs and application follow-ups.
translations.intro_html:
Move your project from site planning towards operation with coordinated approval work. Rapid helps identify the relevant permissions, organise the records and follow the agreed applications, so your architect, plant team and advisers work from the same project facts.

You do not need to begin with a list of acronyms. Tell us what the facility will do, where it is and whether it is proposed, built or already operating.

sections.title: Which approvals belong to which stage?
sections.html:
Project stage Questions to resolve
Site selection Permitted use, ownership/control, access and any land restrictions.
Design and establishment Building, fire-scheme and applicable environmental permissions.
Completion and operation Occupation, fire and operating-consent requirements.
Expansion or renewal Which existing permissions need revision, renewal or a separate application?

This is a planning sequence, not a universal checklist. Haryana TCP and HSPCB publish separate procedures for their services. TCP service list · HSPCB services.

sections.title: Choose the approval you need
sections.html:
Change of Land Use establishes the land-use route for the intended facility.

Building Plan Approval coordinates the proposed building with your appointed architect and the applicable authority.

Occupation Certificate brings the completion records into the occupation-stage process.

PWD Entry and Exit Permission addresses access from the relevant PWD-controlled road.

National Highway Access addresses the separate highway connection and access proposal.

Fire NOC and Scheme Approval connects the building's stage with the required fire application.

Forest Permission identifies the land-status, tree or forest-clearance question behind the request.

Consent to Establish concerns the proposed plant or expansion under the applicable consent framework.

Consent to Operate concerns operation, renewal or changes at the installed unit.

Hazardous Waste Authorisation addresses the specified waste and handling activity.

Warehouse Development and Approval Support distinguishes facility approvals from receipt-based warehouse registration.

Industrial Colony Licensing supports a development of industrial plots and common infrastructure.

Commercial Colony Licensing addresses the commercial plotted-development proposal.

DDJAY Colony Licensing concerns the applicable residential plotted-development route for a developer.

sections.title: What coordinated support gives your team

items.title: A project-specific sequence
items.html: Identify which work can proceed together and what depends on an earlier permission. This is more useful than treating every NOC as an independent purchase.

items.title: Consistent information across files
items.html: Keep the site, entity, capacity and layout aligned so different submissions describe the same project.

items.title: Visible ownership of the next action
items.html: Rapid tracks agreed applications and identifies the record, drawing or response needed from each responsible person.

translations.title: वैधानिक मंज़ूरियाँ
translations.h1: हरियाणा में प्रोजेक्ट की मंज़ूरियों के लिए सहायता
translations.short_description: CLU, बिल्डिंग, फायर, प्रदूषण और संबंधित मंज़ूरियों के दस्तावेज़, आवेदन व फॉलो-अप का समन्वय करें।
translations.intro_html:
साइट चुनने से लेकर यूनिट चालू करने तक, मंज़ूरी के काम को एक साथ व्यवस्थित करें। रैपिड संबंधित आवेदन, दस्तावेज़ और फॉलो-अप संभालता है, ताकि आपके आर्किटेक्ट, प्लांट मैनेजर और CA एक ही प्रोजेक्ट की सही जानकारी पर काम करें।

आपको सभी NOC के नाम याद रखने की ज़रूरत नहीं है। बताएँ कि यूनिट क्या करेगी, कहाँ है और अभी किस चरण में है।

sections.title: किस चरण पर कौन सा सवाल आता है?
sections.nav_label: किस चरण पर कौन सा सवाल आता है?
sections.html:
चरण क्या देखना है
जमीन या साइट चुनते समय उपयोग की अनुमति, रास्ता और जमीन से जुड़ी स्थिति।
डिजाइन व स्थापना बिल्डिंग, फायर स्कीम और लागू पर्यावरण अनुमति।
निर्माण पूरा होने पर ऑक्यूपेशन, फायर और संचालन की ज़रूरतें।
विस्तार या रिन्यूअल पुराने दस्तावेज़ में कौन सा बदलाव या नया आवेदन चाहिए।

यह हर प्रोजेक्ट पर लागू एक जैसी सूची नहीं है। TCP और HSPCB की अलग सेवाओं की अपनी प्रक्रिया है।

sections.title: अपनी ज़रूरत की सेवा चुनें
sections.html:
CLU (English) प्रस्तावित उपयोग के लिए जमीन की अनुमति से जुड़ा है।

बिल्डिंग प्लान (English) आर्किटेक्ट के नक्शे और संबंधित विभाग के आवेदन का समन्वय करता है।

ऑक्यूपेशन सर्टिफिकेट (English) निर्माण पूरा होने के बाद इस्तेमाल के चरण से जुड़ा है।

PWD प्रवेश और निकास (English) संबंधित राज्य सड़क से रास्ते की अनुमति के लिए है।

नेशनल हाईवे एक्सेस (English) हाईवे से प्रवेश और निकास की अलग प्रक्रिया है।

फायर NOC (English) बिल्डिंग की अवस्था के अनुसार फायर स्कीम या NOC का काम है।

वन विभाग की अनुमति (English) जमीन की स्थिति, पेड़ या वन-संबंधी प्रश्न स्पष्ट करती है।

CTE (English) लागू होने पर यूनिट की स्थापना के पहले का पर्यावरण आवेदन है।

CTO (English) संचालन, रिन्यूअल या प्लांट में बदलाव के लिए है।

हैज़र्डस वेस्ट ऑथराइज़ेशन (English) खास अपशिष्ट और उसकी हैंडलिंग से जुड़ा है।

वेयरहाउस विकास और मंज़ूरी (English) बिल्डिंग की मंज़ूरियों को वेयरहाउस रसीद वाले रजिस्ट्रेशन से अलग रखता है।

इंडस्ट्रियल कॉलोनी (English), कमर्शियल कॉलोनी (English) और DDJAY कॉलोनी (English) डेवलपर के अलग लाइसेंसिंग कार्य हैं।

sections.title: व्यवस्थित काम से क्या बदलता है?

items.title: आवेदन का सही क्रम
items.html: पहले कौन सा निर्णय चाहिए और कौन से काम साथ चल सकते हैं, यह स्पष्ट होता है।

items.title: हर फाइल में एक जैसी सही जानकारी
items.html: जगह, संस्था, क्षमता और नक्शा अलग-अलग आवेदनों में एक ही प्रोजेक्ट बताना चाहिए।

items.title: अगले काम की ज़िम्मेदारी
items.html: रैपिड रिकॉर्ड रखता है कि कौन सा कागज़, ड्रॉइंग या जवाब किस व्यक्ति से चाहिए।

sections.title: रैपिड क्या देता है?
sections.html: तय आवेदनों की सूची, दस्तावेज़ चेकलिस्ट, पेशेवर इनपुट की ज़िम्मेदारी और आवेदन व प्रश्नों का रिकॉर्ड। हम फॉलो-अप और जवाब का समन्वय करते हैं। आर्किटेक्ट, इंजीनियर, लैब और कानूनी सलाहकार अपने तकनीकी काम के लिए ज़िम्मेदार रहते हैं; अनुमति का निर्णय विभाग करता है।

sections.title: शुरुआत के लिए रिकॉर्ड
sections.html: लोकेशन, गतिविधि, प्रस्तावित क्षमता, जमीन या लीज के कागज़, उपलब्ध नक्शा और पुरानी मंज़ूरियाँ लाएँ। चालू यूनिट में क्या बदल रहा है, वह अलग से बताएँ।

items.title: 1. प्रोजेक्ट की मौजूदा स्थिति
items.html: साइट, चरण और पुराने रिकॉर्ड देखते हैं।

items.title: 2. काम और निर्भरताएँ तय करना
items.html: आवेदन, ज़रूरी इनपुट और उनकी ज़िम्मेदारी स्पष्ट करते हैं।

items.title: 3. तैयारी और फॉलो-अप
items.html: तय फाइलें और विभागीय जवाब आगे बढ़ाते हैं।

items.title: 4. शर्तें टीम तक पहुँचाना
items.html: मिली अनुमति की शर्तें निर्माण या संचालन करने वाली टीम के रिकॉर्ड में जाती हैं।

sections.title: फीस और समय
sections.html: विभागीय शुल्क, डिजाइन, टेस्टिंग और सुधार के खर्च रैपिड की फीस से अलग हैं। तैयारी और विभागीय समीक्षा का समय भी अलग होता है। सरकारी सेवा की घोषित अवधि को अधूरे प्रोजेक्ट की पक्की मंज़ूरी की तारीख न मानें।

items.title: क्या एक NOC से सब काम हो जाता है?
items.html: नहीं। जमीन, बिल्डिंग और संचालन के प्रश्न अलग हैं।

items.title: काम शुरू कर चुके हैं तो?
items.html: वास्तविक स्थिति और नोटिस बताएँ। उसी आधार पर दायरा तय होगा।

items.title: क्या केवल एक फाइल के प्रश्नों में मदद मिल सकती है?
items.html: हाँ। पूरा आवेदन और टिप्पणियाँ देखकर सीमित काम तय किया जा सकता है।

sections.title: अपने प्रोजेक्ट पर बात करें
sections.html: कारोबार, जगह और मौजूदा ज़रूरत के बारे में बताएँ। रैपिड के विशेषज्ञ सलाहकार आपको कॉल करके काम का दायरा, फीस और अगले कदम समझाएँगे।

sections.title: स्रोत और समीक्षा
sections.html: संबंधित सेवाओं के पेज पर आधिकारिक संदर्भ दिए गए हैं। जानकारी की जाँच 16 सितंबर 2026 को की गई। अतुल गोयल (English) समीक्षा के लिए नामित हैं; विषय की अंतिम विशेषज्ञ समीक्षा अभी बाकी है।

translations.h1: Business Licences and Certifications in Haryana
translations.short_description: Explore FSSAI, IEC, LEI, startup, Udyam, ISO and ZED requirements. Rapid helps identify and coordinate the right business-document route.
translations.intro_html:
Get the right document for the business requirement in front of you. Rapid helps identify the licence, registration or certification involved, prepare the relevant information and coordinate the agreed application or readiness work.

A customer request, food operation, export plan and bank transaction call for different records. We start with that purpose, then explain the route and responsibilities.

sections.title: Registration, licence or certification?
sections.html:
Type What it usually establishes
Registration/identifier A record of an entity or business in a particular system.
Licence Permission for the specified activity through the applicable authority.
Certification Assessment against the named standard or programme.

Their roles are different. A quality certificate does not replace a food licence, and an enterprise registration does not guarantee a subsidy or loan.

sections.title: Choose the document or programme
sections.html:
Udyam Registration explains the free official MSME route and current classification.

Haryana Udyam and HUM Guidance distinguishes the state enterprise record from national Udyam.

FSSAI Registration and Licensing connects the food activity with the current registration, State or Central route.

Importer Exporter Code covers preparation for a new IEC or an existing-code update.

LEI Registration addresses the legal-entity identifier requested for a financial transaction.

Startup Recognition distinguishes DPIIT, state and separate benefit applications.

ISO Certification Support helps prepare a working management system for independent assessment.

MSME ZED Certification explains levels, costs, assistance and manufacturing-unit preparation.

items.title: Choose the correct route first
items.html: An exact buyer or departmental request helps avoid paying for a document that does not meet the need.

items.title: Keep the entity and premises consistent
items.html: Names, addresses, legal form and activity should agree across the records used in the application.

items.title: Prepare practices as well as paperwork
items.html: For certification, the organisation needs evidence of implementation. A certificate request may require work on operating responsibilities, not simply filling a form.

sections.title: What Rapid delivers
sections.html:
Rapid identifies the relevant service discussion, prepares an input checklist and coordinates the agreed application or assessment-preparation records. We track queries and make the next action clear to the applicant and responsible professional.

Government portals, licensing authorities and independent certification bodies retain their issuing roles. The official Udyam route is free; ISO itself does not issue certificates. Rapid's fee, where applicable, concerns the separately agreed advisory work.

sections.title: Information for the first discussion
sections.html: Bring the request you received, business activity, entity details, location, existing certificates and the date by which the document is needed. If a record has changed or expired, explain the change rather than copying an old application.

items.title: 1. Identify the purpose
items.html: Confirm who needs the document and what it is intended to establish.

items.title: 2. Define preparation and ownership
items.html: Agree the records, practical readiness work and professionals involved.

items.title: 3. Coordinate the selected process
items.html: Prepare the agreed file and responses, with the applicant confirming its facts.

items.title: 4. Retain the result and future actions
items.html: Keep the issued scope, update or surveillance obligations and relevant dates visible.

sections.title: Fees and timing
sections.html: Official charges, independent audit/testing costs and Rapid's fee should be separated. A simple identifier application and a factory certification programme require different work and should not carry the same blanket turnaround.

items.title: Do I need to know the exact acronym?
items.html: No. Share the request or describe the purpose.

items.title: Can a certificate cover every group company?
items.html: The issued scope and entity matter. Do not assume a group brand makes all legal entities or sites interchangeable.

items.title: Can we use existing records?
items.html: Yes, after checking their accuracy and relevance to the current application.

items.title: Does the document need renewal?
items.html: It depends on the system. The individual page explains the relevant update, renewal or surveillance question.

translations.h1: बिज़नेस लाइसेंस और सर्टिफिकेशन
translations.short_description: FSSAI, IEC, LEI, उद्यम, स्टार्टअप, ISO और ZED की ज़रूरत समझें और तय आवेदन या तैयारी में सहायता लें।
translations.intro_html:
आपके कारोबार को जिस दस्तावेज़ की ज़रूरत है, उसी के लिए सही तैयारी करें। रैपिड रजिस्ट्रेशन, लाइसेंस या सर्टिफिकेशन का उद्देश्य स्पष्ट करके तय आवेदन और तैयारी का काम आगे बढ़ाता है।

ग्राहक की मांग, फूड बिज़नेस, निर्यात और बैंक की ज़रूरत अलग दस्तावेज़ माँग सकती है। शुरुआत उसी उद्देश्य से करें।

sections.title: इन दस्तावेज़ों में फर्क क्या है?
sections.nav_label: इन दस्तावेज़ों में फर्क क्या है?
sections.html:
प्रकार क्या बताता है
रजिस्ट्रेशन या पहचान संख्या किसी व्यवस्था में संस्था या कारोबार का रिकॉर्ड।
लाइसेंस निर्धारित गतिविधि की अनुमति।
सर्टिफिकेशन तय मानक या कार्यक्रम के अनुसार मूल्यांकन।

क्वालिटी सर्टिफिकेट फूड लाइसेंस की जगह नहीं लेता। रजिस्ट्रेशन से अपने आप ऋण या सब्सिडी मंज़ूर नहीं होती।

sections.title: सही सेवा चुनें
sections.html:
उद्यम रजिस्ट्रेशन (English) मुफ़्त आधिकारिक MSME प्रक्रिया और वर्गीकरण समझाता है।

हरियाणा उद्यम और HUM (English) राज्य के रिकॉर्ड और राष्ट्रीय उद्यम में अंतर बताता है।

FSSAI (English) फूड गतिविधि के अनुसार वर्तमान रजिस्ट्रेशन या लाइसेंस का रास्ता समझाता है।

IEC (English) आयात-निर्यात कोड के नए आवेदन या अपडेट के लिए है।

LEI (English) वित्तीय लेनदेन के लिए कानूनी संस्था की पहचान से जुड़ा है।

स्टार्टअप मान्यता (English) केंद्रीय, राज्य और अलग लाभ आवेदनों में अंतर स्पष्ट करती है।

ISO (English) स्वतंत्र ऑडिट के लिए काम करने वाली मैनेजमेंट प्रणाली की तैयारी है।

ZED (English) मैन्युफैक्चरिंग यूनिट के स्तर, मूल्यांकन, लागत और सहायता समझाता है।

items.title: सही दस्तावेज़ पर खर्च
items.html: जिसने दस्तावेज़ माँगा है, उसकी वास्तविक ज़रूरत समझकर गलत सर्टिफिकेट पर समय और पैसा खर्च करने से बचते हैं।

items.title: रिकॉर्ड में एकरूपता
items.html: नाम, पता, संस्था का प्रकार और गतिविधि आपस में मेल खाने चाहिए। बदलाव हुआ हो तो पुराना रिकॉर्ड बिना जाँच के न दोहराएँ।

items.title: कागज़ और काम साथ चलें
items.html: सर्टिफिकेशन के लिए कई बार रोज़मर्रा की प्रक्रिया और उसके प्रमाण तैयार करने होते हैं। केवल फॉर्म भरना पूरा काम नहीं होता।

sections.title: रैपिड की ज़िम्मेदारी
sections.html:
हम तय सेवा के लिए इनपुट चेकलिस्ट, आवेदन या मूल्यांकन की तैयारी और प्रश्नों का समन्वय करते हैं। आवेदक तथ्यों की पुष्टि करता है। सरकारी संस्था या स्वतंत्र सर्टिफिकेशन बॉडी दस्तावेज़ जारी करती है।

उद्यम का सरकारी रजिस्ट्रेशन मुफ़्त है। ISO स्वयं सर्टिफिकेट जारी नहीं करता। रैपिड की फीस केवल अलग से तय सलाह और समन्वय के काम के लिए होती है।

sections.title: पहली बातचीत में क्या बताएँ?
sections.html: माँगा गया दस्तावेज़ या संदेश, कारोबार, जगह, संस्था के रिकॉर्ड, मौजूदा सर्टिफिकेट और ज़रूरत की तारीख बताएँ। पहचान संबंधी पासवर्ड या OTP पूछताछ फॉर्म में न दें।

items.title: 1. उद्देश्य समझना
items.html: दस्तावेज़ किसे चाहिए और क्यों, यह तय करते हैं।

items.title: 2. तैयारी तय करना
items.html: रिकॉर्ड, वास्तविक सुधार और पेशेवर इनपुट की ज़िम्मेदारी स्पष्ट होती है।

items.title: 3. प्रक्रिया आगे बढ़ाना
items.html: तय आवेदन, तैयारी और प्रश्नों के जवाब का समन्वय होता है।

items.title: 4. आगे की तारीखें रखना
items.html: जारी दस्तावेज़ की सीमा, अपडेट, रिन्यूअल या ऑडिट की ज़रूरत दर्ज रखी जाती है।

sections.title: फीस और समय
sections.html: सरकारी शुल्क, ऑडिट या टेस्टिंग और रैपिड की फीस अलग हैं। एक पहचान संख्या का आवेदन और पूरी फैक्ट्री का सर्टिफिकेशन एक जैसा काम नहीं है। समय और फीस भी उसी अनुसार तय होंगे।

items.title: नाम ठीक से नहीं पता तो?
items.html: मिला हुआ संदेश भेजें या उद्देश्य बताएँ।

items.title: एक कंपनी का सर्टिफिकेट पूरे ग्रुप के लिए चलेगा?
items.html: जारी दस्तावेज़ की संस्था, साइट और दायरा देखना होगा।

items.title: क्या हर दस्तावेज़ हर साल रिन्यू होता है?
items.html: नहीं। संबंधित व्यवस्था की अपडेट या रिन्यूअल शर्त अलग है।

sections.title: अपने प्रोजेक्ट पर बात करें
sections.html: कारोबार, जगह और मौजूदा ज़रूरत के बारे में बताएँ। रैपिड के विशेषज्ञ सलाहकार आपको कॉल करके काम का दायरा, फीस और अगले कदम समझाएँगे।

translations.title: Industrial Insurance
translations.h1: Industrial Insurance and Claim Support
translations.short_description: Explore industrial insurance documentation and claim coordination. Rapid helps organise business records, provider questions and next actions.
translations.intro_html:
Keep your insurance records aligned with your business, and your claim evidence organised when a loss occurs. Rapid supports the documentation and coordination work around cover reviews and claims, alongside the responsible insurer or authorised insurance professional.

The first step depends on the situation: protecting a new investment, reviewing renewal terms or responding to an incident.

sections.title: Choose the support you need
sections.html:
Industrial Insurance helps organise the premises, asset, stock and policy information for a cover discussion.

Insurance Claim Management helps coordinate incident evidence, insurer requests and the outstanding actions in a claim.

sections.title: New cover, renewal or a claim?
sections.html:
Situation Start here
New plant or machinery Asset values, activity, location and lender requirements.
Renewal Current wording, changed exposures and claims history.
More stock or another premises Whether the existing contract needs an endorsement or different cover.
Loss has occurred Safety, timely insurer notification and preservation of evidence.

For a live incident, follow the policy's notification requirements promptly. Do not wait for Rapid's callback before contacting the insurer.

sections.title: What clearer records help you do

items.title: Compare the protection, not only premium
items.html: Sums insured, deductibles, exclusions and conditions can make two quotations materially different.

items.title: Make the actual exposure visible
items.html: A stock peak, added production line or change in storage should be disclosed and reflected in the review.

items.title: Keep claim follow-ups actionable
items.html: An organised record shows what has been supplied, what is awaited and who can provide it.

sections.title: What Rapid delivers
sections.html:
Depending on the selected assignment, Rapid coordinates an asset/policy pack or a claim-document index, records clarification questions and follows up on outstanding inputs. The owner receives a clear view of the evidence and next actions.

Insurance recommendation, solicitation, placement, underwriting and loss assessment belong to appropriately authorised participants. Rapid's published scope here is documentation and coordination; no unverified insurer, broker or surveyor credential is claimed.

sections.title: Information to prepare
sections.html:
For cover review, bring the policy schedule and wording, asset register, stock exposure, site activity and changes since the policy began. For claims, add the incident account, notification acknowledgement, claim reference, loss evidence and correspondence.

The individual service pages explain why each record matters and what the coordination includes.

items.title: 1. Define the requirement and urgency
items.html: Establish whether the work concerns cover, renewal, changes or a notified claim.

items.title: 2. Organise the evidence
items.html: Rapid builds the agreed document record with the business team.

items.title: 3. Coordinate with the responsible provider
items.html: Route questions and follow up on the records needed for the insurer or authorised professional's process.

items.title: 4. Retain the decision and next actions
items.html: Keep the issued policy or claim decision with the outstanding conditions and responsibilities.

sections.title: Premium, fees and outcomes
sections.html:
Premium is determined through the insurer's product and assessment; Rapid's advisory fee is separate. Claim settlement depends on the contract, facts and assessment. Neither a consultancy appointment nor a quotation request proves cover or guarantees payment.

IRDAI provides general-insurance information and grievance guidance. A specific policy's wording remains central to the individual matter.

items.title: Can you obtain every type of cover directly?
items.html: The service must identify the authorised provider and Rapid's coordination scope. We do not claim an unverified placement role.

items.title: Can you guarantee a claim amount?
items.html: No. The insurer's decision follows the applicable contract and process.

items.title: Can you work with our current insurance provider?
items.html: Yes. The assignment can organise records and follow-ups around the responsible provider already involved.

sections.title: Discuss your requirement
sections.html:
Tell us whether the requirement concerns a policy review or an existing claim. An expert consultant from Rapid will call you to understand the requirement and explain the proposed work, fee and next steps.

translations.h1: इंडस्ट्रियल इंश्योरेंस और क्लेम में सहायता
translations.short_description: फैक्ट्री, मशीनरी और स्टॉक के बीमा रिकॉर्ड या क्लेम दस्तावेज़ व फॉलो-अप को व्यवस्थित करने में सहायता लें।
translations.intro_html:
बीमा के रिकॉर्ड को अपने कारोबार की वास्तविक स्थिति से जोड़ें। और नुकसान होने पर क्लेम के प्रमाण व फॉलो-अप व्यवस्थित रखें। रैपिड संबंधित बीमा कंपनी या अधिकृत पेशेवर के साथ दस्तावेज़ और समन्वय का तय काम संभालता है।

नई मशीन का बीमा, पॉलिसी रिन्यूअल और नुकसान के बाद क्लेम, तीनों की शुरुआत अलग जानकारी से होती है।

sections.title: अपनी ज़रूरत चुनें
sections.html:
इंडस्ट्रियल इंश्योरेंस (English) में साइट, मशीनरी, स्टॉक और पॉलिसी के रिकॉर्ड व्यवस्थित किए जाते हैं।

इंश्योरेंस क्लेम सहायता (English) में घटना, नुकसान के प्रमाण और कंपनी के सवालों का रिकॉर्ड व फॉलो-अप संभाला जाता है।

sections.title: किस स्थिति में क्या देखें?
sections.html:
स्थिति शुरुआत किससे करें
नई यूनिट या मशीन संपत्ति की कीमत, उपयोग, जगह और बैंक की शर्तें।
रिन्यूअल मौजूदा पॉलिसी, बदला हुआ जोखिम और पिछले क्लेम।
ज्यादा स्टॉक या नई साइट क्या पॉलिसी में बदलाव चाहिए।
नुकसान हो चुका है सुरक्षा, बीमा कंपनी को समय पर सूचना और प्रमाण सुरक्षित रखना।

घटना होने पर रैपिड की कॉल का इंतज़ार किए बिना पॉलिसी के अनुसार बीमा कंपनी को सूचना दें।

sections.title: व्यवस्थित रिकॉर्ड से क्या मदद मिलती है?

items.title: केवल प्रीमियम नहीं, सुरक्षा की तुलना
items.html: बीमा राशि, कटौती, अपवाद और शर्तें समझें। कम कीमत वाली दो पॉलिसियाँ एक जैसा कवर नहीं भी दे सकतीं।

items.title: वास्तविक जोखिम सामने आता है
items.html: सीजन में बढ़ा स्टॉक, नई मशीन या स्टोरेज में बदलाव को बीमा चर्चा में शामिल करें।

items.title: क्लेम में अगला काम स्पष्ट रहता है
items.html: कौन सा प्रमाण दिया है, क्या बाकी है और किससे चाहिए, इसका रिकॉर्ड रखने से फॉलो-अप उपयोगी बनता है।

sections.title: रैपिड क्या देता है?
sections.html:
तय काम के अनुसार संपत्ति व पॉलिसी का दस्तावेज़ पैक, या क्लेम का दस्तावेज़ इंडेक्स और प्रश्नों का रिकॉर्ड। हम आपकी टीम से इनपुट जुटाने और संबंधित पक्ष से फॉलो-अप का समन्वय करते हैं।

पॉलिसी बेचना, प्लेसमेंट, अंडरराइटिंग और नुकसान का औपचारिक आकलन उचित अधिकृत व्यक्तियों की ज़िम्मेदारी है। यहाँ रैपिड को बीमा कंपनी, लाइसेंस प्राप्त ब्रोकर या सर्वेयर के रूप में प्रस्तुत नहीं किया गया है।

sections.title: क्या तैयार रखें?
sections.html: पॉलिसी शेड्यूल और शर्तें, संपत्ति सूची, स्टॉक, साइट की गतिविधि और बदलाव। क्लेम में घटना का विवरण, सूचना का प्रमाण, क्लेम नंबर, नुकसान के कागज़ और पत्राचार भी दें।

items.title: 1. ज़रूरत और तत्काल काम पहचानना
items.html: नया कवर, रिन्यूअल, बदलाव या क्लेम का चरण समझते हैं।

items.title: 2. प्रमाण व्यवस्थित करना
items.html: टीम के साथ तय दस्तावेज़ रिकॉर्ड तैयार करते हैं।

items.title: 3. संबंधित प्रदाता से समन्वय
items.html: प्रश्न और बाकी इनपुट उचित व्यक्ति तक पहुँचाकर फॉलो-अप करते हैं।

items.title: 4. निर्णय का रिकॉर्ड रखना
items.html: पॉलिसी या क्लेम निर्णय के साथ बाकी शर्तें और अगले कदम स्पष्ट रखते हैं।

sections.title: फीस और परिणाम
sections.html:
प्रीमियम बीमा कंपनी के उत्पाद और आकलन से तय होता है। रैपिड की फीस अलग है। क्लेम भुगतान पॉलिसी, घटना और आकलन पर निर्भर है; सलाहकार रखने से भुगतान की गारंटी नहीं बनती।

IRDAI की जानकारी और शिकायत प्रक्रिया आधिकारिक संदर्भ हैं। विशेष मामले में वास्तविक पॉलिसी की शर्तें देखें।

items.title: क्या तय क्लेम रकम की गारंटी मिलेगी?
items.html: नहीं। बीमा कंपनी लागू प्रक्रिया से निर्णय करती है।

items.title: क्या हमारे वर्तमान बीमा प्रदाता के साथ काम कर सकते हैं?
items.html: हाँ। दायरा उसके साथ रिकॉर्ड और फॉलो-अप के समन्वय पर तय हो सकता है।

items.title: क्या कोटेशन मिलते ही बीमा शुरू हो जाता है?
items.html: नहीं। कवर शुरू होने की पुष्टि बीमा कंपनी की प्रक्रिया से होनी चाहिए।

sections.html: कारोबार, जगह और मौजूदा ज़रूरत के बारे में बताएँ। रैपिड के विशेषज्ञ सलाहकार आपको कॉल करके काम का दायरा, फीस और अगले कदम समझाएँगे।

translations.h1: Business Finance and Project Advisory in Haryana
translations.short_description: Prepare project, equipment and working-capital finance or review existing borrowing. Rapid coordinates business evidence and lender applications.
translations.intro_html:
Put the right funding discussion behind your next business decision. Rapid helps organise the investment, financial evidence and application work for new projects, equipment, operating cash needs and existing-loan reviews.

Start with what the funds need to achieve. The financing structure should fit the business requirement and repayment capacity, rather than the other way around.

sections.title: Choose the funding or advisory requirement
sections.html:
Project Finance brings the cost, contribution and repayment case together for a new unit or expansion.

Equipment Loans connect a machinery purchase with installation costs and its business purpose.

Working Capital addresses the cash gap between purchases, production and customer collections.

Collateral-Free Loans examine the relevant product or guarantee route alongside credit and security conditions.

Balance Transfer and Top-Up compare refinancing and additional borrowing on their full financial effect.

Interest-Rate Reduction examines repricing an existing facility with the current lender.

Real Estate Project Finance organises development costs, approvals and cash-flow evidence.

Land Planning compares development options and the evidence needed before a property commitment.

sections.title: What is the difference between the main facilities?
sections.html:
Need Main question
Long-lived asset or project How will the investment earn enough to service the proposed term debt?
Operating liquidity How much cash is tied up in stock and customer-credit cycles?
Refinance or repricing Does the full cost improve after charges and repayment changes?
Development finance What is the cost to complete and the evidence behind receipts?

Banks offer different structures for business needs. Their product and credit decisions determine the terms. SBI's borrower-education handbook explains common facility types; it is not a commitment of finance to a Rapid client.

items.title: A clear funding amount and purpose
items.html: Separate costs already paid, remaining investment and operating cash needs.

items.title: A credible repayment explanation
items.html: Make the assumptions behind sales, margins and collections visible and consistent with existing records.

items.title: An offer you can compare
items.html: Read rate, tenure, charges, security and release conditions together. A lower EMI alone does not establish a cheaper loan.

sections.title: What Rapid delivers
sections.html:
Rapid coordinates the funding brief, document checklist, application inputs and agreed lender follow-ups. We work with your CA and project team to resolve information gaps and track sanction conditions.

The borrower confirms facts and accepts obligations. The lender decides credit, price, security and disbursement; appointed professionals retain their valuation, legal and certification roles. Rapid is not the lender.

sections.title: Documents to start with
sections.html: Bring the business activity, funding purpose and amount, available financial statements, bank statements, current loans and relevant quotations or project costs. New businesses should separate projections from actual trading history. Existing borrowers should include current sanctions and repayment schedules.

items.title: 1. Define the business need
items.html: Establish the amount, timing and use of funds.

items.title: 2. Organise the evidence
items.html: Coordinate the commercial, financial and project records around the same assumptions.

items.title: 3. Support the authorised application
items.html: Track lender questions and organise the responsible team's responses.

items.title: 4. Make the conditions and next steps clear
items.html: Separate an indicative offer, sanction and actual release of funds. Keep all material obligations visible before commitment.

sections.title: Fees and expected timing
sections.html:
Rapid's fee is separate from lender charges and third-party legal, valuation or technical costs. For applicable loans, request the Key Facts Statement and compare all-in cost. RBI KFS explanation.

The timetable depends on document readiness, credit review and conditions. No universal rate, loan amount or approval date is promised from an initial enquiry.

items.title: Do we need a project report before calling?
items.html: No. Available figures and a clear purpose can define the preparation work.

items.title: Can our CA remain the financial adviser?
items.html: Yes. We coordinate with existing advisers and preserve their responsibility for financial certifications.

items.title: Does collateral-free mean no scrutiny?
items.html: No. Credit assessment and repayment evidence still matter.

items.title: Can subsidies be considered with finance?
items.html: Yes, but subsidy eligibility is separate and expected assistance should not be counted as received cash.

sections.title: Discuss your requirement
sections.html:
Share the funding purpose, amount and stage of the business or project. An expert consultant from Rapid will call you to understand the requirement and explain the proposed work, fee and next steps.

translations.title: फाइनेंस और अन्य सेवाएँ
translations.h1: हरियाणा में बिज़नेस फाइनेंस और प्रोजेक्ट सलाह
translations.short_description: प्रोजेक्ट, मशीनरी, वर्किंग कैपिटल और पुराने ऋण की समीक्षा के लिए रिकॉर्ड, बैंक आवेदन और फॉलो-अप सहायता लें।
translations.intro_html:
आपके कारोबार को पैसा किस काम के लिए चाहिए, वित्त की चर्चा वहीं से शुरू होनी चाहिए। रैपिड नई यूनिट, मशीनरी, रोज़मर्रा की नकदी ज़रूरत और मौजूदा ऋण की समीक्षा के लिए रिकॉर्ड, आवेदन और फॉलो-अप का समन्वय करता है।

ऋण की किस्त ही नहीं, पूरा खर्च, अवधि और शर्तें देखकर निर्णय लें।

sections.title: सही सेवा चुनें
sections.html:
प्रोजेक्ट फाइनेंस (English) नई यूनिट या विस्तार की लागत और चुकौती का आधार तैयार करता है।

मशीनरी लोन (English) उपकरण खरीद और इंस्टॉलेशन की ज़रूरत से जुड़ा है।

वर्किंग कैपिटल (English) स्टॉक खरीदने और ग्राहक से पैसा मिलने के बीच की नकदी ज़रूरत के लिए है।

कोलैटरल-फ्री लोन (English) संबंधित उत्पाद, गारंटी व्यवस्था और बैंक की शर्तें समझाता है।

बैलेंस ट्रांसफर और टॉप-अप (English) ऋण स्थानांतरण और अतिरिक्त उधार की पूरी लागत की तुलना करता है।

ब्याज दर कम कराने की समीक्षा (English) मौजूदा बैंक से ऋण की प्राइसिंग बदलने की चर्चा है। यह कर कटौती की सेवा नहीं है।

रियल एस्टेट फाइनेंस (English) डेवलपमेंट की बाकी लागत, मंज़ूरियों और नकदी प्रवाह से जुड़ा है।

लैंड प्लानिंग (English) जमीन के उपयोग और विकास के विकल्प समझने में मदद करती है।

sections.title: जरूरत के अनुसार वित्त में फर्क
sections.nav_label: जरूरत के अनुसार वित्त में फर्क
sections.html:
ज़रूरत मुख्य सवाल
मशीन या बिल्डिंग लंबे समय के निवेश की चुकौती कैसे होगी।
रोज़मर्रा का संचालन स्टॉक और उधारी बिक्री में कितनी नकदी फँसती है।
पुराना ऋण बदलना शुल्क और नई अवधि के बाद वास्तविक बचत कितनी है।
डेवलपमेंट प्रोजेक्ट काम पूरा करने की बाकी लागत और प्राप्तियों का प्रमाण क्या है।

बैंक अपना उत्पाद और क्रेडिट निर्णय तय करता है। SBI की वर्किंग कैपिटल जानकारी सामान्य सुविधा प्रकार समझाती है, किसी आवेदक की मंज़ूरी नहीं।

sections.title: अच्छी तैयारी से क्या मिलता है?

items.title: स्पष्ट रकम और उद्देश्य
items.html: पहले दिया पैसा, बाकी निवेश और संचालन की नकदी अलग रखें।

items.title: चुकौती का समझने योग्य आधार
items.html: बिक्री, मार्जिन और कलेक्शन के अनुमान वास्तविक रिकॉर्ड से जोड़ें।

items.title: प्रस्ताव की सही तुलना
items.html: दर, अवधि, फीस, सिक्योरिटी और पैसा जारी होने की शर्तें साथ देखें। कम EMI अपने आप सस्ता ऋण नहीं है।

sections.title: रैपिड की भूमिका
sections.html:
हम फंडिंग ब्रीफ, दस्तावेज़ चेकलिस्ट, आवेदन के इनपुट और तय बैंक फॉलो-अप का समन्वय करते हैं। CA और प्रोजेक्ट टीम के साथ बाकी जानकारी जुटाते हैं।

आप तथ्यों और ऋण की शर्तों पर निर्णय लेते हैं। बैंक रकम, दर, सुरक्षा और भुगतान तय करता है। मूल्यांकन, कानूनी जाँच और प्रमाणपत्र संबंधित पेशेवरों की ज़िम्मेदारी हैं। रैपिड ऋणदाता नहीं है।

sections.title: शुरुआत में क्या लाएँ?
sections.html: कारोबार, राशि और उपयोग, वित्तीय विवरण, बैंक स्टेटमेंट, मौजूदा लोन और संबंधित कोटेशन। नए कारोबार में अनुमान को हुई बिक्री से अलग बताएँ। पुराने ऋण के लिए स्वीकृति पत्र और रिपेमेंट शेड्यूल दें।

items.title: 1. फंडिंग की जरूरत तय करना
items.html: कितना पैसा, कब और किस काम में चाहिए, यह स्पष्ट करते हैं।

items.title: 2. रिकॉर्ड तैयार करना
items.html: वित्तीय और प्रोजेक्ट जानकारी एक ही आधार पर व्यवस्थित करते हैं।

items.title: 3. अधिकृत आवेदन और जवाब
items.html: तय बैंक प्रक्रिया में इनपुट और प्रश्नों का समन्वय करते हैं।

items.title: 4. शर्तें और अगले कदम
items.html: ऑफर, मंज़ूरी और वास्तविक पैसा जारी होना अलग पड़ाव हैं। स्वीकार करने से पहले जिम्मेदारियाँ समझें।

sections.title: फीस और समय
sections.html:
रैपिड की फीस बैंक शुल्क, कानूनी और मूल्यांकन खर्च से अलग है। लागू ऋण में बैंक का Key Facts Statement माँगें। RBI की जानकारी इसकी लागत संबंधी भूमिका समझाती है।

समय रिकॉर्ड, क्रेडिट समीक्षा और शर्तें पूरी होने पर निर्भर है। शुरुआती पूछताछ पर निश्चित दर या मंज़ूरी का वादा नहीं किया जाता।

items.title: क्या पहले प्रोजेक्ट रिपोर्ट बनानी होगी?
items.html: नहीं। उपलब्ध आंकड़े काम का दायरा तय करने के लिए पर्याप्त शुरुआत हो सकते हैं।

items.title: क्या अपना CA साथ रख सकते हैं?
items.html: हाँ। उनके इनपुट और ज़िम्मेदारी के साथ काम किया जा सकता है।

items.title: क्या सब्सिडी को भी देख सकते हैं?
items.html: हाँ, लेकिन पात्रता की समीक्षा अलग है। अपेक्षित सहायता को मिला हुआ पैसा न मानें।

sections.title: अपने प्रोजेक्ट पर बात करें
sections.html: कारोबार, जगह और मौजूदा ज़रूरत के बारे में बताएँ। रैपिड के विशेषज्ञ सलाहकार आपको कॉल करके काम का दायरा, फीस और अगले कदम समझाएँगे।

translations.title: Change in Land Use (CLU) Approval
translations.h1: Change of Land Use (CLU) Approval in Haryana
translations.short_description: Understand CLU requirements for a Haryana factory, warehouse or commercial site. Get application, documentation and follow-up support from Rapid.
translations.intro_html:
Put the right land-use permission behind your next factory, warehouse or commercial project. Rapid helps you establish the applicable CLU route, prepare the application and carry the documentation and departmental follow-ups through the agreed assignment.

Start before the building design and land commitment become difficult to change. We work with your site records and proposed activity so the permission being pursued matches the business you intend to run.

sections.title: What is CLU permission?
sections.html:
Change of Land Use permission concerns using land for a purpose different from its permitted use under the applicable planning framework. In Haryana, the first question is the parcel's location, planning jurisdiction and proposed activity. An agricultural revenue entry, an industrial address and an approved industrial use are different pieces of information.

The Town and Country Planning Department publishes controlled-area notifications, development plans and CLU procedures. These establish the route to examine for a particular site. Haryana TCP planning records and services.

items.title: Before buying a development site
items.html: Check the proposed use and access while the purchase is still being evaluated. A low land price can lose its attraction if the intended facility cannot be developed on the expected basis.

items.title: Before a new use or expansion
items.html: An existing permission may describe a particular activity, area or layout. A warehouse replacing another use, or an additional parcel beside a factory, needs to be considered against that actual permission.

items.title: Before finalising the building investment
items.html: Align the land-use position with the architect's proposal and funding assumptions. This gives your team a firmer basis for drawings, project costs and the next approvals.

sections.title: CLU, building approval and ownership: what is the difference?
sections.html:
Question Relevant record or workstream
Who owns or can use the parcel? Title, lease and legal due diligence.
Can the proposed activity use this site? Applicable land-use permission and planning conditions.
Can this building be constructed as designed? Building-plan sanction through the competent authority.
Can vehicles enter from the adjoining road? Road-access review and permission where required.

One application should not be budgeted as a substitute for all four. For construction, continue to Building Plan Approval; for access, see PWD or National Highway access.

sections.title: What Rapid delivers
sections.html:
We organise a site-and-use brief, an application checklist and a record of the outstanding inputs. With your appointed professionals, we coordinate the application package, track queries and help assemble responses. You receive visibility of what has been submitted, what is awaited and who needs to act.

The landowner confirms ownership and transaction facts. The architect, surveyor or legal adviser supplies and signs work within their professional responsibility. The department determines permission and conditions. Rapid manages the agreed coordination rather than substituting for those roles.

sections.title: Documents for a useful first review
sections.html:
Bring What it helps establish
Village, district, khasra details and a location pin The exact site and planning jurisdiction.
Current jamabandi, mutation and ownership or lease records The applicant's connection to the land.
Site dimensions, access and available plans Whether the concept fits the parcel and approach.
Proposed activity and approximate built-up area The use for which permission is being considered.
Existing CLU, notices or earlier applications Conditions or issues the new work must address.

The final application follows the department's service checklist. This first-discussion list is not a title-clearance report.

items.title: 1. Establish the parcel and intended use
items.html: Rapid reviews the available records and identifies the jurisdiction and information still needed for the proposed application.

items.title: 2. Coordinate the application package
items.html: The team brings together plans, applicant records and supporting inputs. You confirm the facts and approve the submission.

items.title: 3. Follow scrutiny and close queries
items.html: Rapid tracks the agreed application, routes technical questions to the responsible professional and coordinates documented responses.

items.title: 4. Hand over the decision and next actions
items.html: We explain the permission record and outstanding implementation steps within our scope, so the next workstream starts from the issued conditions.

sections.title: Costs, timing and permission conditions
sections.html:
Budget separately for departmental charges, surveys and professional drawings, legal work and Rapid's advisory fee. A meaningful estimate needs the location, land area, proposed use and stage of the file. Preparation and authority scrutiny are separate parts of the timetable.

The issued permission controls its conditions and implementation requirements. If the project changes or a condition cannot be met on time, review the position before relying on the old permission.

items.title: Is CLU required for every plot in Haryana?
items.html: No single answer applies to every parcel. Jurisdiction, existing approval and intended use determine the relevant route.

items.title: Can I start construction while CLU is being processed?
items.html: An application acknowledgement is not permission. Establish the approvals required before commencing the proposed work.

items.title: Can Rapid review a site before purchase?
items.html: Yes. We can define a planning-review assignment using the available records, alongside your independent legal and technical due diligence.

items.title: What if an earlier application has a query?
items.html: Share the complete application and correspondence. We can scope the response work around the actual issue instead of starting an unrelated file.

sections.title: Discuss your requirement
sections.html:
Share the village, district, proposed activity and current stage of the site. An expert consultant from Rapid will call you to understand the requirement and explain the proposed work, fee and next steps.

translations.title: PWD Entry & Exit Permission NOC
translations.h1: PWD Entry and Exit Permission in Haryana
translations.short_description: Plan road access for a Haryana factory or warehouse. Understand the documents, authority checks and PWD application support Rapid provides.
translations.intro_html:
Make vehicle access part of the project plan from the start. Rapid coordinates PWD entry and exit permission work for factories, warehouses and commercial premises, bringing the road details, access drawing and application follow-ups together.

For an owner, the goal is practical: an approach that can serve the facility and is considered through the right road authority. That matters before constructing a gate, drain crossing or heavy-vehicle entrance.

sections.title: What does PWD access permission cover?
sections.html:
Access permission concerns the connection between a property and the adjoining road. It is distinct from owning frontage or having an internal driveway. The review needs to establish who controls the road and what works are proposed at the boundary.

Haryana PWD's published code provides the departmental context for road-related works. Exact access conditions need to be confirmed for the relevant road and permission category. Haryana PWD Code.

sections.title: Which access route fits the site?
sections.html:
Site situation First question
State road or another PWD-controlled road Which PWD office and access requirements apply?
National Highway frontage Does the Ministry/NHAI access route apply instead?
Industrial-estate or municipal road Which estate or local authority controls the connection?
Existing entrance being widened or relocated What does the earlier permission allow, and what changes?

A familiar road name is not enough to identify the authority. For National Highways, see NHAI Entry and Exit Permission.

items.title: Fit the vehicles your business uses
items.html: A delivery van, grain truck and articulated trailer need different turning and waiting arrangements. Share expected vehicle sizes with the designer before the gate position is fixed.

items.title: Connect access with the site layout
items.html: The entrance affects circulation, parking, loading and emergency access. Coordinate it with the building and operating layout instead of treating it as an isolated drawing.

items.title: Make the works and budget visible
items.html: Drainage, culverts, boundary works and approach construction can affect cost. An early review helps identify which technical inputs and estimates the project needs.

sections.title: What Rapid delivers
sections.html:
Rapid develops the application brief with your team, identifies the supporting records, coordinates the access proposal prepared by the responsible designer and follows up on the agreed submission. The working file records queries, responses and pending actions.

We coordinate with your surveyor or engineer where technical drawings or calculations are required. Design certification, construction execution and the road authority's decision remain with their respective owners.

sections.title: Documents and site information
sections.html:

sections.title: What is Consent to Establish?

translations.intro_html:
Identify the Haryana business-registration record you need and keep it distinct from national Udyam. Rapid helps owners understand the purpose of HUM and connect their registration position with a wider approval, incentive or project requirement.

If a bank, department or adviser has asked for “Haryana Udyam”, share the exact request. A clear name at the start prevents the wrong document becoming a delay later.

sections.title: What is Haryana Udhyam Memorandum?
sections.html:
HUM is Haryana's enterprise-registration system. The state describes it as a central repository for businesses operating in Haryana, irrespective of size or type, with an Udhyam ID issued through the portal. Haryana MSME Directorate: HUM.

It is different from the national Udyam system used for MSME registration. The similarity in names does not make the records interchangeable.

sections.title: HUM or Udyam: which record is being requested?
sections.html:
Record Purpose and route
Haryana Udhyam Memorandum Haryana enterprise record through the state-linked HUM portal.
National Udyam registration National MSME registration through the Ministry's official system.
A scheme application or approval A separate application with its own eligibility and documents.

For national classification, free registration and the official route, see Udyam Registration.

items.title: A department asks for an enterprise ID
items.html: Confirm the requested identifier and the entity it relates to. Supplying a similar-looking certificate can leave the request unanswered.

items.title: Business details have changed

items.title: You are considering a Haryana incentive

sections.title: What Rapid can help you organise

Rapid clarifies the requested record and helps connect it to the wider advisory assignment. We can identify the enterprise information your project file needs and coordinate questions with the person responsible for the official record.

Use the portal linked by the Haryana MSME Directorate for the registration process. This page does not present Rapid as the issuing authority or as a government registration portal. Any wider advisory fee is described separately from official registration charges.

translations.h1: ISO Certification Support in Haryana
translations.short_description: Choose an ISO standard and prepare a working management system. Rapid supports documentation, readiness and independent audit coordination in Haryana.
translations.intro_html:
Build a management system that your team can use and an independent auditor can assess. Rapid helps Haryana businesses choose a relevant ISO certification scope, prepare documentation and organise the readiness work around the way the business operates.

Start with the reason for certification: a customer requirement, tender, stronger quality control or a wider improvement objective. The right standard and scope follow that purpose.

sections.title: What is ISO certification?
sections.html:
ISO develops standards; it does not issue certificates. An independent certification body audits the relevant management system and makes the certification decision. Rapid's role is preparation and coordination. ISO's explanation of certification.

A management-system certificate concerns the stated organisation, locations and scope. It should not be presented as approval of every product or a replacement for statutory licences.

sections.title: Which standard should you consider?
sections.html:
Business objective Standard family to discuss
Consistent quality and customer requirements ISO 9001, quality management.
Environmental management ISO 14001.
Occupational health and safety management ISO 45001.
A specific customer, sector or tender requirement The exact standard and recognised certification conditions named by the buyer.

Confirm the current edition and transition requirements with the selected certification body. The scope of Rapid's engagement is agreed for the particular standard; this list is not a claim that every specialist certification is delivered in-house. ISO management-system standards.

items.title: Make responsibilities visible
items.html: Clarify who checks incoming material, releases output, maintains equipment or addresses complaints. A system is stronger when staff know the actions behind the documents.

items.title: Reduce repeated quality problems
items.html: Use actual rejection, rework and complaint information to identify causes and follow corrective actions. Documentation should support those decisions.

items.title: Prepare credible evidence for assessment
items.html: Bring procedures, implementation records and reviews together. A generic manual without working evidence does not explain how your business is controlled.

sections.title: What Rapid delivers
sections.html:
Workstream Practical output
Scope and readiness Agreed sites, activities, objective and preparation priorities.
Documentation support A structured set of required documents and evidence responsibilities.
Implementation coordination An action list for the team to close preparation gaps.
Audit coordination Organised inputs and responses for the agreed assessment work.

Your team implements the system. Auditors and the certification body retain independent responsibility for the assessment and decision. Rapid does not issue an ISO certificate.

sections.title: Documents and evidence to bring
sections.html:
Bring the organisation structure, products/services, locations, process flow, existing procedures, quality or incident records, relevant licences and any customer requirement. If already certified, add the certificate, scope, last audit report and open findings.

For a workshop, inspection and calibration records may be useful. For a warehouse, traceability and stock-handling practices may be central. The final evidence depends on the chosen standard and scope.

items.title: 1. Agree the standard and scope
items.html: Start with the business need and identify the organisation and activities to be assessed.

items.title: 2. Prepare and implement the system
items.html: Rapid coordinates the agreed documentation work; your team puts the required practices into operation and keeps evidence.

items.title: 3. Review readiness and address gaps
items.html: Track outstanding actions and prepare the records for the independent assessment.

items.title: 4. Coordinate the audit response
items.html: Organise responses to findings within the agreed scope. Maintain the system after certification and plan the certification body's follow-up assessments.

sections.title: Cost, duration and choosing a certification body
sections.html:
Preparation effort depends on the standard, sites, employee scale, operational complexity and existing systems. Separate Rapid's fee from certification-body audit charges, travel and any testing or implementation costs.

Ask the certification body about its competence, accreditation, scope and recognition for your intended buyer. ISO recommends checking relevant competence and accreditation when choosing a body. A very fast certificate is not evidence of a useful assessment.

The body should state the certification cycle, surveillance and renewal/recertification arrangements. Those are continuing commitments, not merely the initial certificate price.

items.title: Can ISO certification be done without changing daily work?
items.html: If required controls are missing, paperwork alone will not establish implementation. The team needs to operate the system it describes.

items.title: Is ISO 9001 product certification?
items.html: It is a quality-management-system standard, not blanket approval of each product.

items.title: Can we use our existing procedures?
items.html: Yes. Start with practices that work and identify what needs strengthening rather than rewriting everything for appearance.

items.title: How does ZED differ?
items.html: ZED is a separate MSME programme with its own levels and assessment framework. Choose around the objective rather than treating the badges as interchangeable.

translations.title: ZED Certification
translations.h1: MSME ZED Certification
translations.short_description: Understand ZED eligibility, Bronze, Silver and Gold levels, certification costs and subsidies. Get practical assessment-preparation support from Rapid in Haryana.
translations.intro_html:
Build a stronger manufacturing business with ZED certification. Rapid helps Haryana MSMEs choose a suitable certification level, prepare their unit and organise the application and assessment work, with clear responsibility for the support we undertake.

Whether you run a processing unit, engineering workshop or another manufacturing business, start with what you want to improve: product quality, production consistency, workplace practices or readiness for a customer's requirements. We connect that objective to the right next steps.

sections.title: What is ZED certification?
sections.html:
ZED means Zero Defect Zero Effect. The MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification programme assesses manufacturing practices and encourages better quality, productivity and environmental performance. It is a Ministry of MSME initiative implemented by the Quality Council of India (QCI).

For an owner, the practical question is whether the factory can consistently demonstrate how it manages its work. A certificate recognises assessed practices; the preparation should also help your team run the unit better. The programme has three levels: Bronze, Silver and Gold. Official programme overview.

sections.title: What can ZED help your business improve?
sections.intro_html: ZED connects certification with improvements in day-to-day manufacturing. Use the preparation to strengthen the areas that matter most to your business. Ministry update, August 2026.

items.title: Product quality and fewer repeat problems
items.html: Use the preparation to examine where defects, rejection and rework occur. For a machining unit, that could mean bringing inspection results and corrective actions together instead of repeatedly addressing the same customer complaint.

items.title: More dependable daily operations
items.html: Bring attention to maintenance, housekeeping, safety and production responsibilities. The useful result is a working practice that people can follow, with records that show whether it is being followed.

items.title: Better use of energy and materials
items.html: Look at consumption and waste alongside output. That makes it easier to identify where the unit is losing resources and which improvements deserve attention.

items.title: A clearer account of your manufacturing capability
items.html: Give customers a clearer picture of how your unit controls quality and manages production. Check which standards a particular buyer needs alongside ZED.

sections.title: Who is eligible, and is ZED compulsory?
sections.html:
Manufacturing MSMEs registered on Udyam are eligible to participate. ZED is voluntary. It does not replace the permissions needed to operate your unit. Eligibility · Programme guidelines.

Before choosing a level, confirm:

  • The enterprise's Udyam details and the manufacturing unit being assessed.
  • The products and processes carried out at that location.
  • Who can provide the unit's operating records and implement improvements.
  • Whether the objective is a first certification, an upgrade or an approaching expiry.

Different units need separate applications. If you operate several facilities, start by identifying the one the assignment will cover. A business doing only trading or services should confirm its applicable route before paying for manufacturing certification support. QCI application process, April 2026, page 6.

sections.title: Bronze, Silver or Gold: which level should you consider?
sections.html:
Choose a level around the practices your unit can demonstrate and the improvements your team is ready to make. A higher badge alone is not a reason to take on a wider assessment.

Level Assessment coverage How to think about the choice
Bronze 7 parameters, including quality, safety, energy and measurement. A starting point for a unit formalising its core practices.
Silver 14 parameters, extending into areas such as process control, maintenance, materials and environment. Consider it when the team can demonstrate a broader operating system.
Gold 20 parameters, adding areas such as supply chain, risk, technology and resource conservation. Consider it when those wider controls are established across the unit.

Parameter coverage follows the September 2024 amendment, Appendix A. The choice guidance is Rapid's practical framing, not an additional eligibility rule.

You can apply for any level after the ZED Pledge if you can meet its requirements. Bronze is not a compulsory first step before Silver or Gold. QCI application process, page 6.

sections.title: What does ZED certification cost?
sections.html:
The published certification charges below are before applicable financial assistance. They are programme charges, not Rapid's consultancy prices.

Certification level Published charge
Bronze ₹8,000
Silver ₹32,000
Gold ₹72,000

These revised amounts took effect on 18 September 2024. The amendment describes the charges as including verification, assessment, certification, monitoring and applicable taxes; it also specifies separate surveillance charges. Official fee amendment, pages 1–2.

For a useful budget, separate four items:

  1. Certification charges: the amount payable through the programme after applicable assistance.
  2. Surveillance: the follow-up assessment obligations during the certificate's life.
  3. Preparation and improvements: for example, testing, calibration, equipment or operating changes your unit needs.
  4. Rapid's advisory fee: the agreed preparation and coordination assignment, quoted separately.

Rapid's fee is quoted after understanding your unit, chosen level and existing systems. Share these details to receive a scope that distinguishes our work from official charges and third-party expenditure.

sections.title: What subsidy and financial assistance are available?
sections.html:
The Ministry's 2025 scheme booklet lists the following certification-cost support:

Enterprise category Listed support on certification cost
Micro 80%
Small 60%
Medium 50%
Eligible women-owned MSMEs 100%

It also lists a ₹10,000 joining reward, which can make Bronze certification free when availed under the scheme. Additional assistance is listed for specified ownership, location and cluster categories. The amount payable depends on the applicant's category and the applicable reward and subsidy rules. Ministry scheme booklet, ZED section.

Support can extend beyond the certificate:

Support category Published maximum
Eligible testing, system or product certification 75% of cost, capped at ₹50,000
Eligible handholding and consultancy Up to ₹2 lakh
Eligible Zero Effect solutions and technology improvements Up to ₹3 lakh

These are separate forms of assistance with their own conditions. They are not an automatic cash payment to every certificate holder, and do not establish that Rapid's fee will be reimbursed. Ministry update, August 2026.

If assistance is a major reason for your project, discuss the proposed spend before commissioning it. The September 2024 amendment makes relevant testing and certification support prospective from ZED registration. Amendment, page 2.

sections.title: What Rapid supports
sections.html:
You should know what your adviser will produce and who is moving each part of the work forward. We define the assignment around your plant and the certification level you want to pursue.

Workstream Rapid's support What you have to work with
Readiness and level selection Review the current process, records and certification objective with your team. A defined scope and list of preparation priorities.
Documentation and awareness Help organise evidence and explain the records and responsibilities needed for the agreed assessment scope. A working document checklist and clearer responsibilities.
Improvement preparation Review progress with the people implementing changes and identify outstanding actions. An action list showing what is ready and what still needs attention.
Application and assessment coordination Support agreed application preparation, evidence organisation and responses to assessment findings. A coordinated record of submissions, queries and next actions.

Your plant team implements operational changes and confirms the facts supplied. Certification is decided through the programme's authorised process. Rapid's role is to help you prepare and coordinate the work, not to issue the certificate.

sections.title: What documents and records should you prepare?
sections.html:
Bring the records you already use. You do not need a polished file before the first conversation. This is a practical preparation checklist; the programme's application and assessment checklist determines the final requirements.

Information to bring Why it matters
Udyam registration, unit address and authorised contact Identifies the applicant and the facility.
Products, process flow and shop-floor photographs Explains what the factory actually does.
Quality checks, rejection and corrective-action records Shows how defects are detected and addressed.
Maintenance and calibration records Shows how equipment reliability and measurement are managed.
Safety arrangements, training and team responsibilities Connects written procedures to people and daily work.
Energy, material-use and relevant environmental records Helps examine resource use and the evidence available.
Existing ISO certificates and earlier assessment reports Identifies useful systems already in place and findings still open.

For an agro processor, discuss the controls around incoming material and the finished product. For an engineering unit, bring inspection and equipment records. The evidence should describe your actual process, not a generic factory.

items.title: 1. Agree the objective and preparation scope
items.html: Start with the unit, desired level and business reason for certification. Rapid reviews the starting point with your team and sets out the agreed work and fee.

items.title: 2. Organise the application and evidence
items.html: Complete the programme registration and ZED Pledge, select the level and prepare the required information. Rapid supports the parts agreed in the assignment; your authorised representative confirms the submitted facts.

items.title: 3. Put improvements into practice
items.html: The responsible people at the factory address the identified gaps. We help organise the supporting records and review outstanding preparation so that the assessment is based on work the unit can demonstrate.

items.title: 4. Complete assessment and respond to findings
items.html: The authorised assessment process examines the evidence. Rapid coordinates the agreed response support if further information or corrective action is needed. Your team remains involved in the explanation and closure of findings.

items.title: 5. Keep the practices working after certification
items.html:
Retain the certificate and assessment record, track surveillance requirements and keep the underlying systems in use. Discuss any continuing advisory support as a defined follow-on scope.

Applications are made through the official ZED portal. The QCI process document describes registration, verification, assessment and certification.

sections.title: How long does certification take, and how long is it valid?
sections.html:
There is no single turnaround that fits every unit. Preparation, evidence quality, scheduling and closure of findings all affect the completion date. Ask for a plan with separate preparation, submission, assessment and response milestones.

QCI's April 2026 process allows up to five opportunities to close findings within 30 days for Bronze and 60 days for Silver or Gold. These are correction windows, not promised end-to-end delivery times. Certificates are valid for three years. QCI process, pages 6–8.

Bronze has a surveillance assessment after 18 months; Silver and Gold have two surveillance assessments during the cycle. Keep these dates in your compliance calendar. Renewal or a fresh application at expiry must follow the scheme's applicable procedure; it is not automatic. Surveillance amendment · Renewal guidelines, section 3.4.8.

items.title: Can I apply without a consultant?
items.html: Yes. The official portal provides the application route. Advisory help is useful when the unit needs support choosing a level, organising evidence, preparing improvements or coordinating responses. Appoint Rapid for a defined need rather than assuming an adviser is compulsory.

items.title: Is ZED the same as Udyam registration?
items.html: No. Udyam records the enterprise's MSME registration. ZED assesses manufacturing practices under its own framework. Having Udyam does not mean the unit has already passed ZED assessment. See our Udyam guide.

items.title: We already have ISO certification. Is ZED still relevant?
items.html: It may be, depending on your business objective. ZED is a separate programme. Certain existing certifications can support parameter exemptions under the framework, subject to accreditation requirements. Bring the certificate and scope so the existing work can be considered. Parameter-exemption notes · ISO support.

items.title: Does “free certification” mean the whole project is free?
items.html: No. Certification-cost assistance does not automatically cover operational improvements, equipment, testing or a private adviser's fee. Ask for each cost category separately, even if the programme charge payable by your unit is zero.

items.title: Can ZED replace pollution consent or other factory approvals?
items.html: No. Certification and permission to operate answer different questions. Keep relevant statutory approvals in place alongside improvement and certification work.

items.title: Does Zero Effect mean zero pollution?
items.html: No. The programme name is an improvement objective, not a literal assurance of zero emissions or complete environmental compliance.

items.title: Can Rapid guarantee certification or subsidy?
items.html: Rapid can take responsibility for the agreed advisory work and follow-through. The authorised bodies determine certification and assistance. We will define our deliverables and the actions your team needs to complete before work begins.

sections.title: Discuss your plant's starting point
sections.html:
Tell us what you manufacture, where the unit is located and whether you are considering Bronze, Silver or Gold. If you are unsure about the level, start with your business objective.

An expert consultant from Rapid will call you to understand the unit and discuss the preparation, scope and next steps. Based in Hisar, we work with businesses across Haryana.
